shared.closeTitleHtml: Payment acceptance is evolving from a processing function to a control layer.
closeHtml: Organizations that continue to rely on fragmented stacks face rising costs, operational inefficiencies, and limited flexibility. Payabbhi® consolidates this into a single, intelligent platform—enabling institutions to reduce complexity, optimize costs, and scale payment operations with confidence.

know.titleHtml: Build Your Merchant Payments Business with Payabbhi®.
know.textHtml: Modernise merchant acquiring, simplify operations, and unlock new revenue opportunities with one extensible platform.

regions.introTitleHtml: Payabbhi® — Own Your Payments. Build Your Merchant Payments Business.
regions.introHtml: Payabbhi® is a white-label, API-first merchant payments platform that enables banks, PSPs, PayFacs, ISOs, and ISVs to build, operate, and scale their own merchant payments business. It brings merchant onboarding, omnichannel acceptance, transaction management, settlement workflows, reconciliation, partner management, and revenue controls together in one extensible platform, giving organizations greater control over their merchant relationships, technology, operations, and payment economics.

metrics.descHtml: 70% demonstrated reduction in merchant onboarding time
With transaction processing in under 20 seconds

regions.whyTitleHtml: One Platform. Complete Merchant Lifecycle. Greater Control.
regions.whyHtml: Payabbhi® helps payment providers get to market faster, manage operations with greater control, and build stronger payment economics. Its white-label approach, flexible licensing models, and processor-agnostic integration architecture give organizations the flexibility to shape their payment proposition and retain control of the merchant relationship.

caps.descHtml: Launch branded payment propositions with API-first integration, modular services, and developer tools.
Manage onboarding, underwriting, activation, configuration, and ongoing merchant operations through one platform.
Enable payment experiences across POS, e-commerce, mobile, hosted checkout, payment links, and QR-based journeys.
Manage ISOs, ISVs, PayFacs, and multi-entity merchant ecosystems through structured relationships and permissions.
Connect processor integrations, transaction visibility, authentication, and operational controls across payment channels.
Strengthen payment security through configurable risk rules, velocity checks, alerts, and tokenized payment-data handling.
Manage settlement-related workflows, reconciliation, funding visibility, and reporting across merchant operations.
Configure merchant pricing, fees, partner commissions, and revenue-sharing arrangements with greater commercial control.
Extend payment capabilities through REST APIs, modular services, developer tools, and sandbox capabilities.
